docs.title: Ontology for time within ITS
docs.text:
This ontology defines concepts related to time as used within ITS using concepts specified in ISO/IEC 5087-1 and ISO/IEC-5087-2.

This ontology consists of the following patterns:

  • Time Pattern (itsTime)

The ontology also contains the following classes that are not assigned to any pattern:

  • Time Pattern (itsTime)

The formal definition of these patterns is available in TTL Syntax.

docs.title: Formalization for DaySelector
docs.text: Property Constraint applicableDayOfMonth all xsd::gDay applicableDayOfMonth max 30 owl::Thing applicableDayOfWeek all time::DayOfWeek applicableDayOfWeek max 6 owl::Thing applicableMonth all xsd::gMonth applicableMonth max 11 owl::Thing subClassOf TimeThing

docs.text: Property Constraint after all xsd::boolean after exactly 1 owl::Thing offset all time::Duration offset exactly 1 owl::Thing subClassOf TimeThing timeReference all code::Code timeReference exactly 1 owl::Thing

docs.title: Time Pattern
docs.text:
It consists of the following classes:

  • Day Selector
  • Fuzzy Time
  • Instance Of Day Within Month
  • Overall Period
  • Period
  • Public Holiday
  • Special Day
  • Time Period Of Day
  • Time Thing
  • Validity

docs.title: Formalization for TimePeriodOfDay
docs.text: Property Constraint endTimeOfPeriod all FuzzyTime or time::Instant endTimeOfPeriod exactly 1 owl::Thing startTimeOfPeriod all FuzzyTime or time::Instant startTimeOfPeriod exactly 1 owl::Thing subClassOf TimeThing
